body.p: A liar said to his wife: "Hang up the teapot!" When she had hung it up, the liar killed his wife. He cut off a willow, he brought the willow, he started to beat his wife, that one stood up. The liar sold the willow to soldiers, the soldiers took [it]. The soldiers killed their wives, then they started to beat the killed women. Those ones did not revive. They buried [the women] in the earth. The liar put the money, which he had got, onto a tree stump on the steep bank, he started to shoot. When he was shooting, the money fell down. He gave those [bows] to the soldiers. The soldiers bought his bows. They were shooting, they could not shoot the money down. The soldiers got angry on the liar. They put the liar into the belly of a cow. The soldiers went home. A human came to the cow, the liar said: "Let me out". There the human let him out. The liar said to the human: "I have put money into the cow's belly". The human crawled into the cow's belly. The liar took the human's horse, he gallopped to the human's wife. The liar married those one's woman. The soldiers came, they drowned the cow. There the liar said to the soldiers: "I took the woman from the water spirit". The liar killed the cows, he put the soldiers into their bellies, he sewed them up. So the liar put the soldiers into the water, until they died.
